# Vendored rubyevents schemas

JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) generated by rubyevents from their Ruby schema
DSL via `bin/rails schema:export`, committed in their repo under
`lib/schemas/`.

Source: https://github.com/rubyevents/rubyevents at commit
`8312e75e0bad4f3f22f1a04f82ccbadbb3abdc19`.

`videos_schema.json` is a thin array wrapper that `$ref`s `video_schema.json`;
`video_schema.json` inlines its sub-videos. `speaker_schema.json` describes a
single entry of `data/speakers.yml`. Together these five files are the whole
closure for the documents we serve.

All three set `additionalProperties: false`, so they reject fields we invent
or misspell, not only fields we omit.

To refresh, copy the four files from a local clone and update the commit
above. Deliberately a manual step — the test suite makes no network calls.
